name: Ice House Taproom
description: Located on a waterfront near Gulf Shores Beach, we at Icehouse Tap Room have been serving up refreshingly-unique drinks and foods since 2000 in Baton Rouge, LA, and are excited to be opening Icehouse Tap Room in Gulf Shores! We offer a funky indoor space and a beachy outdoor space with an atmosphere that acts as a place for friends, wanderers, and adventurers to share a drink together as equals. The previous business strived for an extremely local atmosphere and Icehouse Taproom will continue that tradition for the area! We look forward to making new friends and seeing old friends. We will have Live Entertainment and exciting Sporting Event watch parties! We can't wait to see everyone!
address_line_1: 112 Windmill Ridge Rd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA
